source: gradevance2/raw/Reflective writing - 2 cycles (ss writing and LCT visualisation)
text: The most difficult aspect of preparing my Gaokao is how to use my limited time to fulfill the most parts of my exam paper. In Gaokao it's a normal and an animist problems that you won't have enough time to write a huge amounts of exam papers. When I was doing my pre-Gaokao exam, For example, the Chinese exam, I always spent most of my time doing the right thing by reading a certain article, therefore I had seldom time for me to complete the final big writing, so I switched my strategies, I completed the big writing first in Gaokao and left a short time for me to complete the read and write, Later I kept on this strategy for me, by leave the last time for the part I used to spend 2 many time on, thus, I can push my potentials to make me read faster and more efficient in order to fulfill their exam.
